entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'd like to start a return for a jersey I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered about 71 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. The jersey is just the wrong size. I tried it on and it's far too tight across the chest. I was hoping to get an exchange for a larger size or just return it.

I understand. Getting the right fit is important. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.

That's great news, thank you. Now, since I'll be handling the shipping and it was difficult to tell the sizing from the website, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? Just to make the exchange a little smoother.

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While I can't provide a discount code for a return due to a sizing preference, I can assure you'll receive a full refund for the jersey once we receive it back at our warehouse. We can process that immediately for you, and I'll email you the pre-paid shipping label right now.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund is what matters most. So you're saying I don't need to do an exchange, I can just re-buy the correct size after the refund?
Exactly. It's often faster that way. I've just sent that return label to the email we have on file. Just pack the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
